verified: PanelLayout is a pure TUI layout model and does not read RunStore, AuditJournal, AOM state or support bundle files.
Wide layout defines stable panes for status bar, navigation rail, run workspace, event feed and command palette.
Narrow layout falls back to a status bar, tab strip, focused panel and command palette.
Pane dimensions are deterministic and validated for bounds, overlap and title fit.
Initial layout snapshot rendering consumes ProjectionSnapshot as immutable render input with source_of_truth=false.
Existing scripted TUI output remains available for automation.
